declarations.name: KakaoAccordion
declarations.summary: Content that opens and closes: FAQs, details, optional sections.
declarations.description: A card that opens and closes to show any content. The header row holds a title, an optional description, optional trailing meta and a chevron that turns; the body takes anything. Built on native <details> / <summary>, so the header is a real disclosure button. Vanilla JS, Shadow DOM, no deps.

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: Title text (or use slot="title").

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Subline below the title (or slot="description"). Takes no space when absent.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Shown open. Reflected by the open property.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Group: of the accordions with the same name in the same document (or shadow root) at most one is open, like <details name>. Opening one closes the others.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: card · tile · row. Forces a look; without it the look comes from the nesting depth (see NESTING).

attributes.name: no-animate
attributes.description: Opens and closes at once.

members.name: show
members.description: force true / false sets the state.

members.name: hide
members.description: force true / false sets the state.

members.name: toggle
members.description: force true / false sets the state.

events.name: accordion-toggle
events.description: { open, name }   every change after the first render: header, method, attribute or the browser (find in page). Also emitted as a trigger (shared/component-api.js). Nested accordions' events bubble through their parents; check event.target.

slots.description: The body.

slots.name: title
slots.description: The title (instead of heading).

slots.name: description
slots.description: The subline (instead of description).

slots.name: meta
slots.description: Short text or a badge after the title; never controls, since the whole header is one button.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Controls such as a small kakao-button, in the header row before the chevron. They sit outside the header button, so clicking them doesn't open or close the accordion, and they stay visible while closed.

kakao.notFor: Parallel views of one area: kakao-tabs.

declarations.name: KakaoActionBar
declarations.summary: Actions on selected items, floating at the edge: "3 selected · Copy".
declarations.description: A floating bar for actions on the items a person has selected or marked: a short summary ("3 marked to fix") and a row of actions ("Show list", "Copy"). Sticky at the bottom (or top) of its container, or fixed to the viewport. With a count it shows itself while something is selected and slides away at 0, and it announces count changes politely. Vanilla JS, Shadow DOM, no deps.

attributes.name: position
attributes.description: bottom (default) · top. The edge it floats at; at the top it stays below the header bar (--kakao-header-bar-rendered-height).

attributes.name: fixed
attributes.description: Fixed to the viewport, centred, instead of sticky inside its container.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: md (default) · sm. Match it to the size of the buttons in the actions slot: it sets the bar's height and radius so the space around the buttons is even and the corners stay concentric (bar radius = button radius + padding).

attributes.name: count
attributes.description: number. With it the bar is shown while the count is above 0, and slides out at 0 (also when empty or not a number). Without it the bar is shown.

attributes.name: count-label
attributes.description: What a count change announces, {count} replaced by the number. Default: the summary's text, else "{count} selected".

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the bar (a region). Default "Selection actions".

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.description: Hides the bar at once, without the slide (removing it slides the bar in).

members.name: count
members.description: number, or null without the attribute; setting null removes it.

members.name: shown
members.description: true while the bar is shown or sliding in (read-only).

slots.description: The summary: what is selected, ideally with the number.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Buttons (kakao-button, the bar's size) or links, in a row that wraps; the main action last.

kakao.notFor: A brief notice: kakao-toast; site navigation: kakao-header-bar.

declarations.name: KakaoAlert
declarations.summary: A lasting message in the content: saved, failed, a warning.
declarations.description: An inline message in the page content: "Settings saved", "Payment failed". A tinted box with an icon, an optional title and the message, optionally closable, optionally hiding itself after a while. Vanilla JS, Shadow DOM, no deps.

attributes.name: tone
attributes.description: info (default) · success · warning · danger. "error" is an alias of danger; unknown values fall back to info. Observed: changing it restyles the alert and updates its role.

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: Title text above the message (or use slot="title").

attributes.name: dismissible
attributes.description: Shows a close button.

attributes.name: close-label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the close button. Default "Close".

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: Auto-hide time in ms. "0" turns auto-hide off. Without it, info and success hide after --kakao-alert-duration (8000ms); warning and danger stay until closed.

attributes.name: no-icon
attributes.description: Shows no icon.

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.description: Hidden. Set by hide() / the timer / the close button, removed by show().

members.name: show
members.description: Shows the alert (fades in) and restarts its timer.

events.name: alert-show
events.description: {}                 shown by show().

events.name: alert-hide
events.description: { reason }         cancelable, before hiding. reason is "close" (button), "timeout" or "method".

events.name: alert-hidden
events.description: { reason }         after the fade, once hidden is set.

slots.description: The message.

slots.name: title
slots.description: The title (instead of heading).

slots.name: icon
slots.description: Replaces the tone's icon.

kakao.notFor: Brief feedback: kakao-toast; a form's errors: kakao-error-summary.

declarations.name: KakaoAnimatedNumber
declarations.summary: A number that rolls its digits when it changes: counters, totals.
declarations.description: Odometer-style rolling digits when the value changes. Vanilla JS, Shadow DOM, no deps.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The number to show (also observed: a new value rolls to it).

attributes.name: locale
attributes.description: BCP 47 locale for Intl.NumberFormat (default en-US).

attributes.name: decimals
attributes.description: Fixed fraction digits (optional).

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: Roll duration in ms (default 600).

attributes.name: sign-display
attributes.description: auto (default) · always · except-zero · negative: Intl signDisplay.

members.name: update
members.description: Animate to the number n (the same as setting value).

kakao.notFor: Numbers that never change: plain text.

declarations.name: KakaoAsideMenu
declarations.summary: Site navigation in a panel opened by a hamburger button.
declarations.description: A slide-in side menu that is completely hidden until opened. Its hamburger button opens it; the panel then makes room for itself by pushing the whole page (the <body>) aside by its own width, or, with effect="squash", by narrowing the page so the content reflows beside the panel. It slides in and shows its content - any markup placed inside the element, which the component moves into the panel (it is light DOM, so a <slot> would not work). A close button inside the panel header closes it again. Vanilla JS, no dependencies.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name / visible title of the panel. Default "Menu".

attributes.name: position
attributes.description: left (default) · right. The side the panel slides in from; the page gives way to the opposite side.

attributes.name: effect
attributes.description: push (default) · squash. How the page gives way: push slides the whole <body> aside by the panel width, so the content keeps its width and moves out of view; squash leaves the body where it is and narrows it, so the content reflows beside the panel. Anything other than squash means push.

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Panel width as a CSS length, e.g. "320px" or "18rem". Default 280px. Also settable via the --kakao-aside-width custom property; the attribute wins while present.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Boolean. Present = panel open, absent = closed. Observed, so el.setAttribute('open', '') / el.toggleAttribute('open') both work. The component keeps it in sync when the user clicks the open/close buttons or presses Escape.

attributes.name: no-open-button
attributes.description: Hide the built-in hamburger button (when the page provides its own trigger and calls .open() / sets `open`).

attributes.name: persistent
attributes.description: Show the panel above a viewport width, as a normal sidebar: no hamburger, no close button, no Escape, no focus trap. The page is NOT pushed - it stays exactly where it is, so pick a width at least (content width + 2 × panel width) or the panel covers the left edge. The value is the min width, e.g. persistent="1440px" (default 1024px when empty). Below it the menu falls back to the drawer behaviour.

attributes.name: list-data
attributes.description: Optional JSON array of nav items, e.g. [{"value":"home","label":"Home","disabled":false}, …] When present, the menu renders a vertical nav list above the slotted content and manages the current item itself.

attributes.name: selected
attributes.description: Value of the nav item marked as current (aria-current). Updated on pick.

events.name: aside-change
events.description: { open: boolean }

events.name: aside-select
events.description: { value, item }   a nav item was picked.

kakao.notFor: Content beside the page: kakao-aside-sheet; actions: kakao-menu.

declarations.name: KakaoAsideSheet
declarations.summary: A panel from a screen edge: details, filters or a form.
declarations.description: A card that slides in from an edge of the viewport, over the page. Modal by default: covered page, focus kept inside, Escape and a click on the covered page close it. Built like <kakao-dialog>: a plain fixed overlay, not <dialog> + showModal(), so phones, tablets and desktops behave the same. Only the corners that face into the page are rounded, so the sheet reads as pushed in from outside the view. Vanilla JS, Shadow DOM, no deps.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Boolean. Present = shown. Observed; kept in sync with show() / hide() / Escape / the scrim / the close button.

attributes.name: side
attributes.description: "bottom" (default) | "top" | "start" | "end". start and end follow the writing direction (dir="rtl" swaps them); "left" / "right" are physical aliases. Read on every open.

attributes.name: for
attributes.description: Ids (space separated) of elements that toggle the sheet on click, like <label for>. They get aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-expanded. Elements added later work too.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name when there is no slot="header" element.

attributes.name: modal
attributes.description: "false" = non-modal: no scrim, no focus trap, no scroll lock; the page stays usable. Escape still closes it while focus is inside. Read when the sheet opens.

attributes.name: no-dismiss
attributes.description: Escape, the scrim and the close button do nothing (the close button is not shown). Only data-close or hide().

attributes.name: no-close-button
attributes.description: Hide the built-in close button in the header.

attributes.name: close-label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the close button. Default "Close".

attributes.name: handle
attributes.description: Bottom sheets: a drag handle above the header. Dragging it (or the header) down far or fast enough closes the sheet.

attributes.name: contained
attributes.description: Render inside the nearest positioned ancestor instead of the viewport, without the modal machinery (no scroll lock, focus move, trap or Escape). For previews.

events.name: sheet-show
events.description: { side }                 it opened.

events.name: sheet-hide
events.description: { reason, returnValue }  cancelable, before a close by the user or hide(). reason: escape · scrim · button (close button or data-close) · swipe · method.

events.name: sheet-hidden
events.description: { reason, returnValue }  it has left (after the slide out). Removing the open attribute directly skips sheet-hide; sheet-hidden then has reason "attribute".

slots.description: The body.

slots.name: header
slots.description: The title, e.g. <h2 slot="header">; it names the sheet.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: The buttons.

kakao.notFor: A short confirmation: kakao-dialog; site navigation: kakao-aside-menu.

declarations.name: KakaoAvatar
declarations.summary: A person, team or bot as a picture or initials; kakao-avatar-group for several.
declarations.description: A person (or a team, a bot) as a small round picture. Shows the image when there is one, the initials of the name while it loads, when there is none or when it fails, and an icon when there is no name either. Optional status dot. Not interactive: it never takes focus; wrap it in a link or a button when it should do something. Vanilla JS, Shadow DOM, no deps.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: Image URL. Loaded lazily (loading="lazy"); the fallback is shown until it has loaded and stays when it fails.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Whose avatar it is: the text alternative, the source of the initials and of the background tone.

attributes.name: initials
attributes.description: Own initials (up to three characters) instead of the derived ones (first letter of the first and of the last word).

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: xs · sm · md (default) · lg · xl

attributes.name: shape
attributes.description: circle (default) · square. square has rounded corners.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: online · away · busy · offline: a dot at the lower end corner. The four differ in shape, not only in colour.

attributes.name: status-label
attributes.description: The status as text for assistive technology. Default "Online", "Away", "Busy", "Offline".

attributes.name: tone
attributes.description: auto (default) · neutral · primary · success · warning · danger. auto picks one of the others, always the same one for the same name; without a name the tone is neutral.

attributes.name: ring
attributes.description: Draws the ring a group draws, on a single avatar.

events.name: avatar-load
events.description: the image has loaded and is shown. detail: { src }

events.name: avatar-error
events.description: the image failed; the fallback stays. detail: { src }

slots.name: icon
slots.description: (avatar) an inline SVG in currentColor, shown instead of initials.
(group) the avatars.

kakao.notFor: Logos and pictures: kakao-image.

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: Show at most this many avatars; the rest becomes "+N".

attributes.name: total
attributes.description: How many there are in all, when the page only renders the first few: "+N" then counts up to this number.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: xs · sm · md (default) · lg · xl. As on the avatar; applies to every avatar in the group.

attributes.name: shape
attributes.description: circle (default) · square. As on the avatar; applies to every avatar in the group.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Names the group (role="group") for assistive technology.

attributes.name: more-label
attributes.description: The text read for "+N". Default "{count} more".

kakao.notFor: Logos and pictures: kakao-image.

declarations.name: KakaoBadge
declarations.summary: A short read-only status label: "New", "Missing", "Draft".
declarations.description: A small pill-shaped status label: "New", "Proposed", "Missing". Not interactive: it never takes focus and is read as plain text. Vanilla JS, Shadow DOM, no deps.

attributes.name: tone
attributes.description: neutral (default) · primary · success · warning · danger · ink

attributes.name: outline
attributes.description: Hairline border, muted text, no fill (ignores tone).

slots.description: The text, in sentence case.

kakao.notFor: Clickable, removable or filter labels: kakao-chip.

declarations.name: KakaoBreadcrumb
declarations.summary: Where the page sits in a hierarchy, as a trail of links.
declarations.description: Where the current page sits in a hierarchy, built from title/url pairs. The trail starts with a home item: a house icon by default, or the start text. The last item is the current page. Vanilla JS, Shadow DOM, no deps.

attributes.name: list-data
attributes.description: JSON array of items (never "data"). Each item is { "title": "…", "url": "…" } or a pair ["Title", "/url"]. The url is optional; the last item is always the current page (aria-current="page", not a link).

attributes.name: start
attributes.description: icon (default) · text · none. icon: a house icon, named by the start text. text: the start text. none: no start item.

attributes.name: start-text
attributes.description: The start text for this breadcrumb. Default: KakaoBreadcrumb.startText, which starts as START_TEXT ("Start").

attributes.name: start-url
attributes.description: Where the start item links. Default "/".

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark. Default "Breadcrumb".

events.name: breadcrumb-navigate
events.description: { title, url, index }  cancelable; index is the position in the trail (0 is the start item unless start="none"). preventDefault() keeps the browser from following the link (for single-page apps).

kakao.notFor: The steps of a flow: kakao-stepper.

declarations.name: KakaoButton
declarations.summary: Every action: buttons, toggles, dropdown buttons, async .run(promise).
declarations.description: Light-DOM button web component with variants, sizes, icons, toggle, a dropdown menu form and async loading states (via .run(promise)). Load button.css in the page.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The button's text (and its name).

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: primary (default) · secondary · ghost · danger

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: sm · md (default) · lg

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: Optional shortcut: icon-font classes put on an <i>, e.g. icon="fas fa-gear". Only draws when the page loads that icon font (Font Awesome is not part of the library). A slotted icon wins over it.

attributes.name: icon-position
attributes.description: left · right · only: left is the default with a label, only without one (give it an aria-label or a label, which then names the button and is shown as its hover tooltip).

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Not clickable, dimmed.

attributes.name: toggle
attributes.description: A toggle button: off dimmed at weight 400, pressed full at 600.

attributes.name: pressed
attributes.description: The toggle's state.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: button (default) · submit · reset

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form participation, as on a native button.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Form participation, as on a native button.

attributes.name: form
attributes.description: Form participation, as on a native button.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Renders a link that looks like the button.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: The name when there is no visible label.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Hover tooltip. An icon-only button defaults it to its name; title="" turns that off. With kakao-tooltip loaded (before or after this script), every button with a title (its own, on any button, or the icon-only default) puts that text in data-tooltip on the inner <button> instead, so the themed tooltip shows it (also on focus and touch long-press) and no native one; a data-tooltip of your own on the host wins. The button reacts to the tooltip's "tooltip-ready" trigger.

attributes.name: list-data
attributes.description: JSON array of items (never "data"): [{ "value": "light", "label": "Light", "disabled"?: true }, …] Turns the button into a menu button: a trailing chevron, and a click (or ↓ / ↑ / Enter / Space) opens the list below it. The list stays on screen: it opens upwards when there is no room below, and from the button's right edge when it would run off the right side (shifted in if neither edge fits).

attributes.name: selected
attributes.description: Value of the checked item (role="menuitemradio"). Updated on pick.

attributes.name: show-selected
attributes.description: Show the selected item's label instead of label (label is then the menu's accessible name: "Theme: Dark").

attributes.name: no-chevron
attributes.description: Hide the chevron (e.g. a "⋯" actions button). An icon-only dropdown then stays a circle; with the chevron it is a pill.

events.name: kakao-button-action
events.description: on click (not while loading; not for menu buttons)

events.name: kakao-button-select
events.description: { value, label, previous, x, y }  a menu item was picked (x / y: viewport point of the pick, for effects that start there)

type.text: CustomEvent<{ value, label, previous, x, y }>

events.name: kakao-button-menu
events.description: { open }  the menu opened or closed

events.name: kakao-button-menu-hover
events.description: { value, label, index }  the pointer moved onto a different menu item. Mouse only (keys and taps don't fire it), so a listener can follow the pointer, e.g. a theme menu switching the page as the pointer passes. It fires again after the pointer left the menu or the menu was reopened.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: A child with slot="icon" is the icon: an inline , or an icon-font element. Light DOM has no real slots, so the button moves that child into the icon position and keeps it there across updates. The button draws its own glyphs (chevron, spinner, success check) as inline SVG: no icon font needed.

kakao.notFor: Links in text: <a>; copying: kakao-copy-button.

declarations.name: KakaoCard
declarations.summary: A box that groups content, with an optional header and footer.
declarations.description: A content card: optional header, body, optional footer. When the footer starts with a <kakao-button>, the card gets a very subtle, blurred radial glow in that button's colour, rising from the bottom left where the button sits. Vanilla JS, Shadow DOM, no deps.

attributes.name: no-glow
attributes.description: Never show the glow.

attributes.name: theme-glow
attributes.description: Glow in the theme's primary colour after a theme change, when no footer button decides the colour (see THEME TRIGGER GLOW).

attributes.name: no-animate
attributes.description: Don't animate height changes.

slots.description: The body.

slots.name: header
slots.description: The title row, e.g. <h3 slot="header">. Empty: no header row.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: Actions or a note under the body, e.g. a row of buttons. Empty: no footer row.

kakao.notFor: Content that collapses: kakao-accordion; a message: kakao-alert.

declarations.name: KakaoCheckbox
declarations.summary: A yes/no choice, or one item of a check list, submitted with a form.
declarations.description: A checkbox with a label, optional hint, indeterminate state and three sizes. Form-associated: `name` / `value` are submitted while checked. Vanilla JS, Shadow DOM, no deps.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Visible label next to the box (also its accessible name).

attributes.name: hint
attributes.description: Smaller line under the label.

attributes.name: checked
attributes.description: Checked state; reflected when the user toggles.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Form participation.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Form participation.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form participation.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Form participation.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: "sm" | "md" (default) | "lg".

attributes.name: error
attributes.description: Error text under the box (red) - also the validation message.

events.name: input
events.description: native events, as a checkbox fires them

events.name: change
events.description: native events, as a checkbox fires them

events.name: checkbox-change
events.description: { checked, indeterminate, value, previous }

kakao.notFor: Settings that apply at once: kakao-switch-group; one of several: kakao-radio-group.

declarations.name: KakaoChip
declarations.summary: A compact tag, token or filter; can link, act or be removed.
declarations.description: A compact label for file types, tokens, tags or filters. Optional colour swatch, icon and muted secondary text. It can be a link or an action button, removable, or both. Vanilla JS, Shadow DOM, no deps.

attributes.name: tone
attributes.description: neutral (default) · primary · success · warning · danger · ink

attributes.name: swatch
attributes.description: A CSS colour: a small square before the label.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Renders the label as a real link; target and rel pass through.

attributes.name: action
attributes.description: Renders the label as a button that fires chip-action (ignored with href).

attributes.name: removable
attributes.description: Adds a remove button (see EVENTS).

attributes.name: remove-label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the remove button. Default "Remove <label>".

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Passed back in the chip-remove event.

events.name: chip-action
events.description: { label, value }   the action button was activated.

events.name: chip-remove
events.description: { label, value }   cancelable. Unless cancelled, the chip removes itself and focus moves to the next removable chip's remove button, else the previous one's.

slots.description: The label, cut off with an ellipsis when it does not fit.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: A leading icon, e.g. <i slot="icon" class="fas fa-file">.

slots.name: meta
slots.description: Muted text after the label.

kakao.notFor: A read-only status: kakao-badge.

declarations.name: KakaoChipList
declarations.summary: A wrapping row of kakao-chip elements that glide into place.
declarations.description: A wrapping row of <kakao-chip>s. When a chip leaves, it fades out where it was and the others glide to their new places, across row breaks too; the list's height follows instead of jumping. New chips fade in. Light DOM (needs chip-list.css), vanilla JS, no deps.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the list (role="list"; each child is a listitem).

kakao.notFor: Typing new tags: kakao-tag-input.

declarations.name: KakaoCode
declarations.summary: Code in a sentence: a file:line reference, a command, a name.
declarations.description: Inline code in running text: a file:line reference, a command, a setting name. Monospace on a tinted fill, wrapping anywhere on a narrow screen. Light DOM: code.css draws it, so it looks right before (and without) this script; the script only keeps translators off it (translate="no"). Vanilla JS, no deps.

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.description: Not shown.

cssProperties.name: --kakao-code-font
cssProperties.default: var(--kakao-font-mono, ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace)

kakao.notFor: Several lines or a log: kakao-code-block; keyboard keys: kakao-kbd.

declarations.name: KakaoCodeBlock
declarations.summary: Code, preformatted text or a running log, with copy.
declarations.description: Preformatted text: a snippet of code, a config file, a command's output, a running log. Monospace in the theme's colours, scrolling past a maximum height (or wrapping long lines), with an optional label row and a copy button. In log mode it follows the end as lines arrive, unless the reader scrolled up. The content is always shown as text, never as HTML. Vanilla JS, Shadow DOM; the copy button is kakao-copy-button.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The label row's title (a file name, "Output") and the scroller's accessible name. Default name "Code" ("Log").

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Shown in the label row ("sh", "json"); display only, there is no highlighting.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: code (default) · log. log: follows the end, drops old lines past max-lines, overwrites a line on a carriage return and drops ANSI colour codes.

attributes.name: wrap
attributes.description: Wraps long lines instead of scrolling sideways.

attributes.name: max-height
attributes.description: Height cap, any CSS length ("none": no cap). Default from the settings (24rem). Taller content scrolls.

attributes.name: max-lines
attributes.description: Log mode: the most lines it keeps; older ones are dropped. Default 1000; 0 keeps all.

attributes.name: no-copy
attributes.description: No copy button.

attributes.name: copy-label
attributes.description: The copy button's name. Default "Copy" + the label, else "Copy code" ("Copy log").

attributes.name: latest-label
attributes.description: The button that scrolls a log back to its end. Default "Jump to latest".

attributes.name: announce

declarations.summary: Picking or dropping files, with a list of the selection.
declarations.description: File picker with a drop area instead of the native button, and a growing list of the selected files. Every pick or drop ADDS to the list, so files can be collected from several folders one after another. Each file gets a thumbnail (a real preview for images, a type icon otherwise) and a remove button. The drop area has a dotted background that follows the pointer. Vanilla JS, Shadow DOM, no dependencies.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Visible label above the drop area. Default "Files".

attributes.name: hint
attributes.description: Small text in the drop area. Default: built from accept/max-size.

attributes.name: accept
attributes.description: Same syntax as <input accept>: ".pdf,image/*,application/json". Enforced for dropped files too (the file dialog filters by itself).

attributes.name: multiple
attributes.description: Default ON. multiple="false" (also "off", "0", "no") keeps a single file: a new pick replaces it.

attributes.name: max-files
attributes.description: Maximum number of files in the list. Default: unlimited.

attributes.name: max-size
attributes.description: Maximum size per file: bytes or "500KB", "5MB", "1GB".

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Blocks picking, dropping and removing.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name. The element is form-associated: every file is submitted under this name, and form.reset() clears the list.

members.name: files
members.description: Array<File> currently in the list (read-only copy).

members.name: addFiles
members.description: Add files (FileList or array); same rules as a pick.

events.name: files-change
events.description: { files, added, removed }  after the list changed.

events.name: file-reject
events.description: { file, name, reason }      a file was not added. reason is "type" | "size" | "max-files" | "duplicate" | "folder".

slots.name: button
slots.description: Replaces the "Browse files" button (created as a light-DOM kakao-button by default, so the page's button.css styles it).

kakao.notFor: Files already stored: kakao-table.

declarations.name: KakaoFlow
declarations.summary: Even vertical space between blocks: sections, form fields, paragraphs and cards.
declarations.description: A vertical flow: one consistent gap between its children, none before the first or after the last, whatever margins the page gives headings and paragraphs. For the sections of a page, the fields of a form, the blocks of a card. Light DOM: flow.css draws it, so a server-rendered page is spaced before (and without) this script; the script only defines the tag. Vanilla JS, no deps.

attributes.name: gap
attributes.description: sm · md (default) · lg: the space between children, from the spacing tokens (0.5rem: a heading and its text; 1rem: blocks; 2rem: sections).

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.description: Not shown.

kakao.notFor: Columns: kakao-grid; a pile of overlapping cards: kakao-stack; a row of buttons: a flex row.

declarations.name: KakaoGrid
declarations.summary: Columns that wrap by width: cards, stat tiles, fields side by side.
declarations.description: A responsive grid: as many equal columns as fit at a minimum width, one column on a phone, with a token gap. For cards, stat tiles, fields side by side. Light DOM: grid.css draws it, so a server-rendered grid is laid out before (and without) this script; the script only defines the tag. Vanilla JS, no deps.

attributes.name: min
attributes.description: sm · md (default) · lg: the narrowest a column gets (12rem, 18rem, 24rem); never wider than the grid, so a phone shows one column. Without it, --kakao-grid-min sets any length.

attributes.name: gap
attributes.description: sm · md (default) · lg: the space between cells, from the spacing tokens (0.5rem, 1rem, 2rem).

attributes.name: fill
attributes.description: Boolean. Keeps the empty columns: one or two items stay one column wide instead of stretching across the row.

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.description: Not shown.

kakao.notFor: Rows of data: kakao-table or kakao-grid-view; one column of sections: kakao-flow; a pile of cards: kakao-stack.

declarations.name: KakaoGridView
declarations.summary: A data grid with a filter row, sorting and paging.
declarations.description: A data grid in the manner of Yii2's GridView: a kakao-table with a filter row under its headings (a search field or a dropdown per column), an action column (view / edit / delete or your own buttons per row), a summary line ("Showing 1–20 of 143") and a kakao-pagination below. It filters, sorts and pages the rows in the browser, or leaves all three to the server and sends the filters as GET parameters (UserSearch[email]=…), and it decorates a server-rendered table in place. On a phone each row wraps into a block of label / value pairs (the table's wrapped form); the filters open from a "Filters" button above the blocks and the actions sit at the bottom of each block.

attributes.name: list-data
attributes.description: JSON { "columns": […], "rows": […] }: the grid owns the rows. A column takes the table's keys (key, label, type, align, sortable, width, hideLabel) plus: filter   true | "search": a search field; ["a", "b"] | [{ "value", "label" }] | { "type": "select", "options": […] }: a dropdown (first option "All", value ""). Optional "placeholder". From script also match(value, query, row) → boolean. actions  ["view", "update", "delete"] and / or objects { name, label, icon, url, tone, confirm, method, visible }: icon is a built-in glyph (view, update, delete, filter) or icon-font classes; url a template ({id}, {action}, any {key} of the row, URL-encoded) that makes it a link; tone "danger"; confirm a question ({key} filled); method "post" (a link sent as a form, Yii's data-method); visible a row key that must be truthy. delete brings confirm and tone. The column's heading is read out only. A row: an object by column key (or an array in column order). Its id is row[row-key], else its position in all rows. "selected": true preselects it.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: "server": the grid does not filter, sort or page. Filter changes go to the server as GET parameters (see filter-url); sorting is the table's server form; the pager gets total-items / page / page-size / page-url. A grid without rows of its own (server markup) always works so.

attributes.name: page
attributes.description: The page shown, 1-based. Default 1.

attributes.name: page-size
attributes.description: Rows per page, default 20. "0": no paging.

attributes.name: page-sizes
attributes.description: "10,20,50": a rows-per-page select on the pager.

attributes.name: total-items
attributes.description: Server mode: the number of rows, for the pager and summary.

attributes.name: page-url
attributes.description: Server mode: the pager's link template ("?page={page}").

attributes.name: filter-name
attributes.description: Field name template of generated filters, "{key}" replaced: "UserSearch[{key}]" for Yii2. Default "{key}".

attributes.name: filter-url
attributes.description: Server mode: where filters are sent. Default: the current address. Its query is kept, minus the filter fields and "page".

attributes.name: filter-delay
attributes.description: Milliseconds of no typing before a search filters in the browser. Default 300.

attributes.name: action-url
attributes.description: Default link template for actions without a url: "/user/{action}?id={id}" (Yii's ActionColumn).

attributes.name: hide-summary
attributes.description: No summary line.

attributes.name: empty-text
attributes.description: Passed to the table the grid creates (sort only at the start, and when the attribute changes). A kakao-table written inside is used as it is.

attributes.name: empty-label
attributes.description: Passed to the table the grid creates (sort only at the start, and when the attribute changes). A kakao-table written inside is used as it is.

attributes.name: empty-heading
attributes.description: Passed to the table the grid creates (sort only at the start, and when the attribute changes). A kakao-table written inside is used as it is.

attributes.name: empty-message
attributes.description: Passed to the table the grid creates (sort only at the start, and when the attribute changes). A kakao-table written inside is used as it is.

attributes.name: sort
attributes.description: Passed to the table the grid creates (sort only at the start, and when the attribute changes). A kakao-table written inside is used as it is.

members.name: columns
members.description: Property form of list-data. Columns may carry render(value, row, column) as on the table.

members.name: rows
members.description: Property form of list-data. Columns may carry render(value, row, column) as on the table.

members.name: filters
members.description: { key: value } of the filters. Setting it fills the fields and filters (no event).

members.name: page
members.description: The page and the page size.

members.name: pageSize
members.description: The page and the page size.

members.name: selected
members.description: Ids of the selected rows, on every page. Settable.

members.name: clearFilters
members.description: Empties every filter and applies it (fires filter-change).

members.name: refresh
members.description: Draws again (after rows were changed in place).

events.name: filter-change
events.description: { filters, params, url, source } before a filter change applies: filters by column key, params by field name, url where server mode goes (else null), source "user" | "clear". Cancelable: in the browser the rows stay as they are; in server mode the page does not navigate (load it yourself).

events.name: row-action
events.description: { action, id, row, href } after a confirmation, if any. row is the row object (null for server markup), href the link (else null). Cancelable: a link is not followed.

kakao.notFor: A table without filters: kakao-table.

declarations.name: KakaoHeaderBar
declarations.summary: The page's sticky top bar: title, navigation, actions.
declarations.description: The page's top bar: a sticky <header> (the banner landmark) with a start, a centre (title) and an end region, plus an optional navigation region. Transparent at the top of the page; once the page is scrolled, a translucent page-coloured background with a backdrop blur and a hairline below it. Vanilla JS, Shadow DOM, no deps.

attributes.name: nav-label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the navigation region. Default "Main".

attributes.name: scrolled
attributes.description: Set while the window is scrolled down (the bar toggles it).

attributes.name: no-scroll-watch
attributes.description: Don't watch the window: the page sets / removes scrolled itself (previews, pages that scroll inside a container).

slots.name: start
slots.description: At the inline start (left): a menu button, a logo.
The title, centred in the bar while there is room.

slots.name: nav
slots.description: Links, wrapped in a <nav> after the title. Without children no <nav> landmark is exposed.

slots.name: end
slots.description: At the inline end (right): theme switch, settings, account.

kakao.notFor: Headings inside the page: h2 to h6, or kakao-section-header with a count and actions.

declarations.name: KakaoImage
declarations.summary: An image that keeps its place, with a skeleton while it loads.
declarations.description: An image that keeps its place while it loads: a skeleton of the image's size until the file is there, then the picture fades in. Loads lazily, takes the alt text and an optional caption below (figure and figcaption). When the file fails, the frame shows a muted icon and the alt text instead. Not interactive. Vanilla JS, Shadow DOM.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: Image URL. Without it (and without srcset) the skeleton stays: set src later to load.

attributes.name: alt
attributes.description: The text alternative: what the image shows, for people who cannot see it. Also shown in the frame when the image fails. alt="" (or no alt) marks a decorative image that assistive technology skips; write a real text for every image that carries meaning.

attributes.name: caption
attributes.description: Text below the image. Content in slot="caption" replaces it.

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Width of the image: a number is pixels, anything else a CSS length ("20rem", "50%"). Default: the full width of its place. Never wider than its place.

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: Height (number or CSS length). Two numbers for width and height work like on : they give the ratio, and the image scales down with its place without distortion.

attributes.name: ratio
attributes.description: Aspect ratio of the frame: "16/9", "4:3", "1". Give width and height, or ratio, so the space is reserved and the page does not jump when the image arrives. With neither, the skeleton has the placeholder height from the settings and the image then takes its own size.

attributes.name: fit
attributes.description: cover (default) · contain. cover: the image fills the frame, cut where needed. contain: the whole image, with free space around it.

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: Corner radius (number or CSS length). Default: the setting.

attributes.name: srcset
attributes.description: Passed on to the .

attributes.name: sizes
attributes.description: Passed on to the .

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: lazy (default) · eager. lazy: loads when it comes near the viewport. eager: loads at once (for the image at the top of a page).

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.description: The native attribute: no image, no space.

members.name: reload
members.description: Loads the image again, e.g. after an error.

events.name: image-load
events.description: the image has loaded and is shown. detail: { src, currentSrc, naturalWidth, naturalHeight }

events.name: image-error
events.description: the image failed; the error state is shown. detail: { src }

slots.name: caption
slots.description: Replaces the caption attribute; links and markup allowed.

kakao.notFor: People: kakao-avatar; icons: inline SVG.

declarations.name: KakaoKbd
declarations.summary: Keyboard keys and shortcuts in text: "Ctrl + K".
declarations.description: Keyboard keys as keycaps: a single key ("Esc"), a combination ("Ctrl + K") or a sequence ("G then I"). Small and inline: it sits in running text, next to menu items and beside buttons. Not interactive: it never takes focus. Vanilla JS, Shadow DOM, no deps.

attributes.name: keys
attributes.description: The keys (see above). Wins over the text content.

attributes.name: platform
attributes.description: auto (default) · mac · other. auto is detected from the browser. Decides what Mod means and whether modifiers are symbols.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: sm · md (default)

attributes.name: outline
attributes.description: No fill; border and text take the surrounding text colour, so the keys work on any background (a tooltip, a coloured row).

attributes.name: then-label
attributes.description: The word between the steps of a sequence. Default "then".

attributes.name: list-data
attributes.description: JSON object that renames keys, e.g. for another language: {"ctrl": "Strg", "enter": "Eingabe", "esc": "Abbruch"}. Keys are the names above in lower case (the main one of each line: cmd, ctrl, alt, shift, enter, backspace, tab, esc, space, del, home, end, pageup, pagedown, up, down, left, right). The name replaces the word, and what a screen reader says for a symbol.

kakao.notFor: Code and file names: kakao-code; several lines: kakao-code-block.

declarations.name: KakaoList
declarations.summary: A 3D picker: rows tilt in perspective as they scroll past the middle.
declarations.description: A 3D picker list: rows tilt away in perspective as they scroll past the middle, with optional group headings. Vanilla JS, Shadow DOM, no deps. For a plain styled list of short items, use kakao-plain-list instead.

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Component width in px (default 260).

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: Component height in px (default 360).

attributes.name: item-height
attributes.description: Row height in px (default 44).

attributes.name: max-tilt
attributes.description: Max perspective tilt in degrees (default 65).

attributes.name: groups
attributes.description: true (default) · false: show group headings.

attributes.name: list-data
attributes.description: JSON array of groups (never "data"): [{ "group", "names": [] }].

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables interaction when present.

events.name: item-select
events.description: { name, index }   a row was picked

events.name: item-action
events.description: { name, index }   a row's chevron button was pressed

events.name: scroll-end
events.description: the list reached its top or bottom

kakao.notFor: A plain list of short items (file:line, test names): kakao-plain-list.

declarations.name: KakaoMenu
declarations.summary: A menu of actions from a trigger or a right-click.
declarations.description: A menu of actions that opens from any trigger, or as a context menu on right-click. Groups with headings, separators, icons, shortcuts, a danger tone, checkbox and radio items, link items and submenus. The WAI-ARIA menu pattern (menu / menuitem / menuitemcheckbox / menuitemradio, arrow keys, type-ahead). Vanilla JS, Shadow DOM, no deps.

attributes.name: list-data
attributes.description: The items (see above).

attributes.name: for
attributes.description: Id of the trigger. A click opens and closes the menu; Down and Up on the trigger open it on the first or last item. The trigger gets aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded (on the button or link inside it, when the trigger is not one itself).

attributes.name: context-for
attributes.description: Id of an element whose context menu this is: right-click, long-press on touch, Shift+F10 or the Menu key.

attributes.name: placement
attributes.description: bottom-start (default) · bottom-end · top-start · top-end. Where the menu sits against its trigger. It flips to the other side when there is no room.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the menu. Default: the trigger's text, else "Menu" (KakaoMenu.texts.menu).

attributes.name: keep-open
attributes.description: Checkbox and radio items do not close the menu.

attributes.name: inline
attributes.description: The menu is shown in place, always open (for a settings column, a preview). Submenus still open beside it.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: The menu does not open.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Reflects the open state; setting it opens at the trigger.

members.name: open
members.description: open against an element (default: the trigger)

members.name: openAt
members.description: open at a point in the viewport

members.name: items
members.description: the items as an array (get / set)

events.name: menu-select
events.description: an item was picked: { value, item, checked }. `item` is the entry from list-data, `checked` the new state of a checkbox or radio item. Cancelable: preventDefault() keeps the menu open, leaves the check as it was and stops a link.

events.name: menu-open
events.description: the menu opened

events.name: menu-close
events.description: the menu closed

kakao.notFor: Picking a value: kakao-select; navigation: kakao-aside-menu.

declarations.name: KakaoMeter
declarations.summary: A measurement in a known range: "55 GB of 100 GB used".
declarations.description: A gauge, like native <meter>: a measurement within a known range ("55 GB of 100 GB used"). One bar, styled as a sibling of <kakao-progress>; the fill colour shows whether the value is good (optimum region), so-so (suboptimal) or bad (even less good), with the native low / high / optimum rules. Vanilla JS, Shadow DOM, no deps.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Current amount, default 0, clamped to min…max.

attributes.name: optimum
attributes.description: Where the best value lies, default the middle of the range. Decides which region is good, as on native <meter>: low < optimum < high: low…high good, outside so-so optimum <= low:       up to low good, up to high so-so, above bad optimum >= high:      from high good, from low so-so, below bad good = success colour, so-so = warning, bad = danger.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Text above the bar; also the accessible name unless the page set aria-label. Without a visible label, give it aria-label.

attributes.name: show-value
attributes.description: Shows the percentage of the range (or value-text) at the end of the label row, in tabular figures.

attributes.name: value-text
attributes.description: Text for the value instead of the percentage; also becomes aria-valuetext ("92 GB of 100 GB, almost full").

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: sm · md (default) · lg: bar height and label text size.

kakao.notFor: The progress of a task: kakao-progress.

declarations.name: KakaoMultiDropdown
declarations.summary: Several dropdowns that form one value (day | month | year).
declarations.description: Several separate dropdowns joined into one input group that holds a single value, e.g. a date "dd.mm.yyyy" (Day | Month | Year) or a product variant "Size / Colour". Segments can offer an "Unknown" choice, so a partly known date such as 00.00.1990 ("sometime in 1990") is a valid value. Vanilla JS, Shadow DOM, no deps.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Visible label. Default "Value".

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: "date" builds day / month / year segments (dd.mm.yyyy). Without it, segments come from list-data.

attributes.name: list-data
attributes.description: JSON array of segments (never "data"): { name, label?, placeholder?, shortPlaceholder?, options, unknown?, separator? } placeholder: text of an empty box (default: the placeholder attribute, else "Please select"). shortPlaceholder: shown instead when the box is too narrow for the placeholder (default: the segment label; dates use DD / MM / YYYY). options: strings or { value, label?, disabled? }. unknown: true, or { value, label, display } to add an "Unknown" choice. label is used in the list and for screen readers; display is what the closed box shows (default "–"). separator: text after this segment (overrides the attribute).

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The joined value, e.g. "00.00.1990". Reflects the current value once every segment has one, "" while incomplete.

attributes.name: separator
attributes.description: Text between the parts in the joined value (not drawn; the boxes sit edge to edge). Default "." for type="date", " " else.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Text of empty boxes. Default "Please select". Boxes too narrow for it fall back to each segment's short placeholder.

attributes.name: allow-unknown
attributes.description: Adds an "Unknown" option. Empty / "true" = every segment, or a comma list of segment names ("day,month"). For dates the unknown value is zeros ("00", "0000"); for custom segments "?" unless the segment sets its own.

attributes.name: min-year
attributes.description: type="date": first year in the list. Default 1900.

attributes.name: max-year
attributes.description: type="date": last year. Default: the current year.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Blocks all interaction.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: With a form: an incomplete value fails validation.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name (the element is form-associated).

members.name: value
members.description: Get / set the joined value ("" while incomplete).

members.name: setData
members.description: Replace the segments (same shape as list-data).

events.name: dropdown-change
events.description: { value, parts, complete, unknown: [segment names] } after any segment changed (also when a day was clamped).

type.text: CustomEvent<{ value, parts, complete, unknown: [segment names] }>

events.name: dropdown-open
events.description: { segment }    a segment's list opened.

events.name: dropdown-close
events.description: { segment }

kakao.notFor: One choice: kakao-select; a date with a picker: kakao-date-input.

declarations.name: KakaoNumberInput
declarations.summary: Stepper arrows for a child <input type="number">.
declarations.description: Wraps a child <input type="number"> with custom stepper arrows and wheel on the arrow strip. Native browser spin buttons are hidden. Vanilla JS, light DOM: load number-input.css.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: sm · md (default). sm is a compact control (styling hook via number-input.css).

attributes.name: touch-steppers
attributes.description: Always use the touch layout (it is used on touch screens anyway): 44px − and + buttons instead of the stacked ▲▼.

attributes.name: plus
attributes.description: left · right · false: where the + button sits in the touch layout ("off", "0" and "no" also hide it). Default right.

attributes.name: minus
attributes.description: left · right · false: the same for the − button.

attributes.name: grouped
attributes.description: Keep the two buttons together as one joined cluster (the default). "false" / "off" / "0" / "no" gives two separate buttons with a gap instead. A visible group sits on group-position, whatever plus / minus say.

attributes.name: group-position
attributes.description: left · right (default): the side of that group.

kakao.notFor: A value on a scale: kakao-slider.

declarations.name: KakaoPage
declarations.summary: The page's content column: max-width, side padding, space below the header bar.
declarations.description: The page container: centres the page's content at a readable maximum width, pads its sides (and a phone's notch), starts just below the sticky header bar and keeps its end clear of a fixed kakao-action-bar. Light DOM: page.css draws it, so a server-rendered page is laid out before (and without) this script; the script only defines the tag. Vanilla JS, no deps.

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: narrow · normal (default) · wide · full: the maximum width, padding included (45rem: one column of text or a form; 72rem; 96rem: tables and dashboards; none).

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.description: Not shown.

kakao.notFor: Columns of cards: kakao-grid; space between sections: kakao-flow; a framed box: kakao-card.

declarations.name: KakaoPagination
declarations.summary: Page links for a long list.
declarations.description: Page links for a long list: previous / next, the page numbers with an ellipsis window, and a compact form ("1–20 of 143" with previous / next) that it falls back to by itself when it gets too narrow. It stands alone: a table or grid puts one below itself and listens for `page-change`. Vanilla JS, Shadow DOM, no deps.

attributes.name: page
attributes.description: The current page, 1-based. Default 1. Clamped to the number of pages; the attribute reflects the state.

attributes.name: total-pages
attributes.description: Number of pages. Or give:

attributes.name: total-items
attributes.description: Number of items, with

attributes.name: page-size
attributes.description: items per page (default 20). The page count is derived, and the summary can say "21–40 of 143". With neither total the pager is open-ended: the compact form with "Page 3", and next stays available until `last` is set.

attributes.name: last
attributes.description: Open-ended only: marks the current page as the last one.

attributes.name: siblings
attributes.description: Pages shown on each side of the current one. Default 1.

attributes.name: boundaries
attributes.description: Pages always shown at the start and at the end. Default 1. The number of slots stays the same on every page, so the pager does not change width while paging.

attributes.name: url
attributes.description: Link template: "{page}" is replaced by the page number and "{page-size}" by the page size ("?page={page}&per-page={page-size}"). With it the controls are links; without it, buttons.

attributes.name: first-last
attributes.description: Adds first-page and last-page controls (full form).

attributes.name: summary
attributes.description: Shows the summary text in the full form too.

attributes.name: page-sizes
attributes.description: Comma-separated page sizes ("10,20,50"): adds a "Rows per page" select. A native select, or a kakao-select where select.js is loaded.

attributes.name: collapse
attributes.description: auto (default) · always · never. auto: compact when the page numbers do not fit the element's own width. always: always compact. never: the page numbers wrap instead.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: sm · md (default) · lg: the button heights (36, 44, 52px).

attributes.name: hide-single
attributes.description: Renders nothing while there is only one page.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Nothing can be activated (while rows are loading).

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark. Default "Pagination". Give each pager on a page its own when there are several.

events.name: page-change
events.description: { page, previous, pageSize, source }  a control was activated (source "user") or a method called ("api"). attributes.name: hidden

declarations.name: KakaoStepSwitch
declarations.summary: A switch with several positions on one track: low, medium, high.
declarations.description: A multi-position switch: one thumb, any number of steps in between. It keeps the squash & stretch feel of <kakao-switch-group>: the thumb flattens when grabbed, can be dragged with a finger or mouse, snaps to the nearest step on release with a springy overshoot, and rubber-bands into the wall when you drag past either end. Vanilla JS, Shadow DOM, no dependencies.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the radiogroup. Default "Step switch".

attributes.name: list-data
attributes.description: JSON array of steps (never "data"). Each entry is either a string/number or an object: { value: string, label?: string, disabled?: boolean } "value" defaults to the index, "label" to the value.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The value of the selected step. Changing it moves the thumb (animated); user input and setValue() write it back, so the attribute always reflects the current state. If it matches no step, the first enabled step is selected.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Boolean. Blocks all interaction, removes the control from the tab order and sets aria-disabled="true" on the host.

attributes.name: thumb-drag
attributes.description: Dragging the thumb. Default ON; "false" / "off" / "0" / "no" turns it off (taps on a step and the keyboard still work).

attributes.name: show-labels
attributes.description: Step labels under the track. Default ON; "false" hides them.

attributes.name: show-ticks
attributes.description: Small dots marking the steps inside the track. Default ON.

attributes.name: color-shift
attributes.description: Boolean, default OFF. When present, the track colour blends from track-bg-off at the first step to track-bg-on at the last as the thumb moves. Without it the track keeps one colour (--kakao-step-switch-track-bg).

members.name: setData
members.description: Replace all steps (same shape as list-data). While it works the host has aria-busy="true".

members.name: setValue
members.description: Select a step by value. Ignored if disabled / unknown.

members.name: getIndex
members.description: Index of the selected step (-1 if there are none).

members.name: stepBy
members.description: Move the selection by delta enabled steps (clamped).

members.name: focusStep
members.description: Move keyboard focus to a step.

events.name: step-ready
events.description: { count }

events.name: step-change
events.description: { value, label, index, previousValue, previousIndex, source }   source: "pointer" (tap/drag) | "keyboard" (arrows, Home, End) | "click" (Space/Enter, label click, assistive tech) | "api" | "attribute"

type.text: CustomEvent<{ value, label, index, previousValue, previousIndex, source }>

events.name: step-focus
events.description: { value, index }

events.name: step-drag-start
events.description: { value, index }

events.name: step-cross
events.description: { value, label, index, previousValue, previousIndex, source }   the step the thumb is *visually* over, reported whenever it moves into a different one: while dragging, and while the thumb springs to a new step (a tap two steps away crosses the step in between). source is the same vocabulary as step-change: "pointer" / "keyboard" / "click" for a pick, "api" / "attribute" when a setValue() or the value attribute started the flight. Disabled steps are never reported.

type.text: CustomEvent<{ value, label, index, previousValue, previousIndex, source }>

events.name: step-drag
events.description: { progress, overdrag, nearestIndex, nearestValue } progress 0..1 across the whole track, overdrag is the signed rubber-band amount (-1..1) past either end.

events.name: step-drag-end
events.description: { value, index, changed, cancelled } Fires after step-change when the drag changed the step.

declarations.name: KakaoStepper
declarations.summary: Where someone is in a multi-step flow: a wizard, a checkout.
declarations.description: Where someone is in a multi-step flow (a wizard, a checkout): numbered steps that are done, current or upcoming, joined by lines. It shows progress; the page owns the step content. Vanilla JS, Shadow DOM, no deps.

attributes.name: list-data
attributes.description: JSON array of steps (never "data"). Each step is a string (the label) or { "label", "description"?, "value"?, "state"? }. state "error" marks a step as failed (danger colour, a mark and the word "Error" for screen readers); state "done" marks a step as done wherever it sits (a skipped or prefilled step).

attributes.name: current
attributes.description: The current step: its 0-based index, or the value of a step that has one. Default 0. Steps before it are done, steps after it upcoming. An index equal to the number of steps means the flow is finished: every step is done, none is current. The attribute always reflects the state.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: horizontal (default) · vertical. horizontal: markers in a row, labels below. vertical: markers in a column, labels beside them.

attributes.name: collapse
attributes.description: auto (default) · always · never. What a horizontal stepper does when it is too narrow. auto: when a step would get less than --kakao-stepper-min-step-width, it becomes one line ("Step 2 of 4" and the current label) over a segmented bar. "always": always that compact form. "never": always the row.

attributes.name: clickable
attributes.description: Makes steps buttons. Present (or "done"): the steps before the current one. "all": every step but the current one. Without it nothing is focusable.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the list. Default "Progress".

events.name: step-select
events.description: { index, value, label, previousIndex }  cancelable. A clickable step was activated (click, Enter, Space). Unless preventDefault() is called the stepper moves to that step.

events.name: stepper-change
events.description: { index, value, label, previousIndex, source }  the current step changed; source is "select" (a clicked step) or "api" (next / previous / goTo / the current property). Changing the attribute does not fire it.

type.text: CustomEvent<{ index, value, label, previousIndex, source }>

declarations.name: KakaoSwitchGroup
declarations.summary: On/off switches for settings that apply at once.
declarations.description: A production-ready, fully accessible group of toggle switches with a fluid "squash and stretch" animation, built with vanilla JS + Shadow DOM.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible group label (used as aria-label on the group container). Default: "Switch group".

attributes.name: list-data
attributes.description: Array of switch definitions. NEVER use the reserved `data` attribute name. Shape: [{ name, label, checked, disabled }] An item with label "" draws no label and is named by the group's label (a single switch beside its own label, e.g. in a kakao-setting).

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: "horizontal" (default) | "vertical"

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the entire group, sets aria-disabled on the host, and blocks all interaction.

attributes.name: thumb-drag
attributes.description: Lets the user grab the thumb (the dot) with a finger or mouse and drag it along the track. On release the thumb snaps to whichever end it is nearer to. Dragging past either end squashes the thumb into the end of the track: it widens into the wall while the side facing away from the wall turns into a squircle edge, so it looks like the thumb's volume is pressed into the corner. It springs back on release. The thumb is clipped at the track's inner edge (the inset), so it can never bleed into the padding. Default: ON. Turn it off with thumb-drag="false" (also "off", "0", "no"). Taps, clicks and the keyboard work either way. JS property: thumbDrag (boolean). (Deliberately not called `draggable`: that is a native HTML attribute which would switch on browser drag-and-drop for the host element.)

attributes.name: color-labels
attributes.description: Default OFF. When present, the label of a checked switch takes the "on" colour (--kakao-switch-label-color-on, which follows --kakao-switch-track-bg-on unless set) and fades back when it is turned off. "false" / "off" / "0" / "no" turn it off. JS property: colorLabels.

attributes.name: async
attributes.description: Default OFF. Every user toggle first fires a cancelable "switch-request" event whose detail has waitUntil(promise). If a listener hands it a promise, the thumb moves to the new end and shows a spinning loader; on resolve the change is committed ("switch-change") and a checkmark draws in briefly before the thumb settles, on reject the track turns red, the thumb shows an X, and after a moment it springs back ("switch-error"). Without waitUntil the toggle is immediate. JS property: async.

attributes.name: loading-delay
attributes.description: Default 300. Milliseconds an async toggle waits before showing its loader. Requests that finish sooner show no loader and no checkmark, the switch just stays (failures always show red + X). Once shown, the loader stays at least 400ms. 0 shows it immediately. JS property: loadingDelay.

events.name: switch-change
events.description: detail: { name, index, checked } Fired whenever a switch is toggled by the user or via setChecked().

events.name: switch-focus
events.description: detail: { name, index } Fired when keyboard/roving focus moves to a switch.

events.name: group-ready
events.description: detail: { count } Fired once after the first render completes.

events.name: switch-drag-start
events.description: detail: { name, index, checked } Fired when a press on a switch turns into a drag (after a few pixels of movement). Plain taps do not fire it.

events.name: switch-drag
events.description: detail: { name, index, progress, overdrag } Fired on every pointer move while dragging. progress runs from 0 (thumb at the off end) to 1 (thumb at the on end). overdrag is 0 while the pointer is within the track, and eases towards -1 (past the off end) or +1 (past the on end) the further the pointer goes beyond it.

events.name: switch-request
events.description: detail: { name, index, checked, waitUntil(promise) } Only with the async attribute. Fired before a user toggle is applied. Call waitUntil() synchronously in the listener to make the toggle wait for the promise. preventDefault() cancels the toggle.

events.name: switch-error
events.description: detail: { name, index, checked, error } Only with the async attribute: the promise rejected and the switch is returning to its previous state. checked is the state that was refused.

kakao.notFor: Choices submitted with a form: kakao-checkbox.

declarations.name: KakaoTable
declarations.summary: A data table around a server-rendered <table>: sorting, selection, phone layout.
declarations.description: A data table: sortable headings, row selection, a sticky header, striped, dense and bordered forms, an empty and a loading state. On a narrow element (a phone) each row wraps into a block of label / value pairs, the column heading as the label, so no column is squeezed or hidden.

attributes.name: list-data
attributes.description: JSON { "columns": […], "rows": […] }. The component then draws the table itself. Texts are set as text, never HTML. A column: key, label, type ("text" | "number"), align ("start" | "center" | "end"; a number is "end"), sortable, width (a number is px, else a CSS length), hideLabel (the heading is only read out, and the wrapped cell has no label: an action column). A row: an object by column key, or an array in column order. Its id is row[row-key], else its position. Also read: "selected": true, and "data": { … } (data-* on the <tr>). null, undefined and "" are empty cells.

attributes.name: row-key
attributes.description: The row property that holds the id, default "id".

attributes.name: sort
attributes.description: The sorted column, Yii2 style: "name" ascending, "-name" descending. Reflected when the user sorts.

attributes.name: sort-mode
attributes.description: "server": headings only fire sort-change and show the state; the page loads the rows. Anything else sorts the rows in the browser.

attributes.name: selectable
attributes.description: A checkbox per row and "select all" in the heading.

attributes.name: selection-name
attributes.description: name of the row checkboxes (value: the row id), so the selection submits with a form: "selection[]" for Yii2.

attributes.name: sticky-header
attributes.description: The heading row stays at the top while the page scrolls (offset: --kakao-table-sticky-top). Not in the wrapped form, where there is no heading row.

attributes.name: striped
attributes.description: Every other row on a subtle fill.

attributes.name: dense
attributes.description: Less row padding, smaller text.

attributes.name: bordered
attributes.description: A frame around the table and lines between the columns.

attributes.name: scroll
attributes.description: Opt-in: never wraps the rows. A table wider than its frame scrolls sideways in it, with the edge fade on each side that has more. --kakao-table-max-height also lets it scroll down in the frame (the sticky header then sticks to the frame).

attributes.name: layout
attributes.description: auto (default) · stacked. stacked wraps the rows at every width; auto wraps them while the element is narrower than --kakao-table-stack-below (its own width, not the window's).

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Placeholder rows instead of the rows (kakao-skeleton where it is loaded), aria-busy and a spoken "Loading".

attributes.name: loading-rows
attributes.description: How many placeholder rows. Default: as many as there were rows, at most 10; 5 for a table without rows.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the table, when it has no <caption>.

attributes.name: empty-text
attributes.description: Shown in an empty cell, default "—".

attributes.name: empty-label
attributes.description: What a screen reader hears for it while empty-text has no letter or digit, default "Not set".

attributes.name: empty-heading
attributes.description: Heading of the empty state (no rows), default "Nothing to show".

attributes.name: empty-message
attributes.description: Its message.

attributes.description: Accessible name when there is no visible label.
