declarations.name: KakaoTextarea
declarations.summary: A multi-line text field, optional counter and auto-grow.
declarations.description: A multi-line text field: label, hint, error, an optional character counter and optional auto-growing (up to max-height). Form-associated. Vanilla JS, Shadow DOM, no deps.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Visible label above the field.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Used when there is no visible label (e.g. the label sits beside the field).

attributes.name: hint
attributes.description: Helper text below the field (hidden while there is an error).

attributes.name: error
attributes.description: Error text: red field and message; aria-invalid, describedby.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Placeholder text.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The current value (reflected back on input).

attributes.name: rows
attributes.description: Initial visible rows (default 3).

attributes.name: maxlength
attributes.description: Maximum characters; with counter it shows "n / max".

attributes.name: minlength
attributes.description: Minimum characters (checked once the person has typed).

attributes.name: counter
attributes.description: Show the character counter (needs maxlength for the total).

attributes.name: autosize
attributes.description: Grow with the content (up to max-height), no scrollbar until then.

attributes.name: max-height
attributes.description: Height cap for autosize (any CSS length, default 18rem).

attributes.name: resize
attributes.description: "vertical" (default) | "none" | "both" | "horizontal".

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form participation. Validity follows the inner textarea (required, minlength, maxlength; a longer value set from script is too long as well), with the browser's message; `error` takes precedence.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Form participation. Validity follows the inner textarea (required, minlength, maxlength; a longer value set from script is too long as well), with the browser's message; `error` takes precedence.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Form participation. Validity follows the inner textarea (required, minlength, maxlength; a longer value set from script is too long as well), with the browser's message; `error` takes precedence.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: Form participation. Validity follows the inner textarea (required, minlength, maxlength; a longer value set from script is too long as well), with the browser's message; `error` takes precedence.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: "sm" | "md" (default) | "lg".

events.name: input
events.description: every keystroke (value and counter already updated)

events.name: change
events.description: when the field loses focus

kakao.notFor: One line: kakao-text-input.

declarations.name: KakaoThemeSwitch
declarations.summary: Switches the colour theme; load its script early in the head.
declarations.description: A button that switches the page between colour themes: light and dark by default, any number of themes via list-data. The new theme spreads over the page as a soft-edged ripple from the button. Vanilla JS, Shadow DOM, no deps.

attributes.name: list-data
attributes.description: JSON array of themes, in switching order (never "data"): { value, label?, scheme?: "light" | "dark", icon?: "sun" | "moon" } Default: light, dark. scheme defaults to "dark" for a value containing "dark", else "light"; icon follows the scheme. (data-bs-theme always gets the colour-scheme the theme's CSS sets.)

attributes.name: storage-key
attributes.description: localStorage key for the choice. Default "kakao-theme". Empty ("") = don't remember.

attributes.name: show-label
attributes.description: Also show the current theme's name next to the icon.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Blocks switching.

members.name: theme
members.description: Get / set the current theme by value (no ripple).

members.name: setTheme
members.description: options: { animate?: boolean, fade?: boolean, x?, y?, storageKey?, source? } - x / y (viewport px) is where the ripple starts; fade: true cross-fades the colours instead of revealing a snapshot (see FADE). storageKey overrides where the choice is remembered, and "" remembers nothing - for a page that changes the theme for show, not as the visitor's preference. source is reported on theme-change (see EVENTS).

events.name: theme-change
events.description: { theme, previous, scheme, source: "user" | "api" | "storage" | "demo", color } after the theme on <html> changed: on the switch, or on document for the page-level setTheme(). color is the new theme's primary colour (--kakao-color-primary), so other components can tint themselves with it.

type.text: CustomEvent<{ theme, previous, scheme, source: "user" | "api" | "storage" | "demo", color }>

kakao.notFor: Other settings: kakao-switch-group.

declarations.name: KakaoTimeInput
declarations.summary: A time field with the browser's picker; the value is ISO 24-hour.
declarations.description: A time field that keeps the browser's own field and picker, dressed as the library's other fields: label, hint, error, three sizes, the picker icon on the right where the select's chevron sits. The field shows 12 or 24 hours as the browser and the OS are set; the value is always ISO 24-hour. The sibling of <kakao-date-input>. Form-associated. Vanilla JS, Shadow DOM, no deps.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Visible label above the field.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Accessible name when there is no visible label.

attributes.name: hint
attributes.description: Helper text below the field (hidden while there is an error).

attributes.name: error
attributes.description: Error text: danger border and message, aria-invalid, and the validation message.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The default value, ISO 24-hour: 14:30 · 14:30:15 · 14:30:15.250. Form reset goes back to it.

attributes.name: min
attributes.description: ISO times. min after max is a range over midnight (22:00 to 06:00), as on the native field.

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: ISO times. min after max is a range over midnight (22:00 to 06:00), as on the native field.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: In seconds (default 60). Below 60, or not whole minutes, the field shows seconds and the value carries them.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form participation.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Form participation.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Form participation.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: Form participation.

attributes.name: autocomplete
attributes.description: Form participation.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: "sm" | "md" (default) | "lg".

attributes.name: now
attributes.description: Shows a small tag in the row under the field that sets the current time, rounded to step (counted from min; without step the minute), like a user edit (input and change once each). Outside min / max it stays but is disabled (aria-disabled, with a title and an accessible description saying why); hidden while disabled or read only.

attributes.name: now-label
attributes.description: The tag's text. Default from Intl in the locale: "Now" ("Jetzt", "Maintenant" …).

attributes.name: locale
attributes.description: Language tag for the inner field. Without it the nearest `lang` (the element's own, an ancestor's, <html>) is used, and followed when it changes.

members.name: value
members.description: Get / set the ISO value ('' when empty or incomplete).

members.name: valueAsDate
members.description: The time on 1970-01-01 UTC, or null.

members.name: showPicker
members.description: Opens the native picker where the browser allows it, otherwise focuses the field. Needs a user gesture.

events.name: input
events.description: while the value changes

events.name: change
events.description: when the user commits a value (picker, or leaving a segment)

kakao.notFor: Dates: kakao-date-input.

declarations.name: KakaoToast
declarations.summary: Brief notices in a corner that go away by themselves.
declarations.description: A notification region fixed to a corner of the viewport. Its toasts are older ones behind it, a little smaller, fainter and tilted back. Hovering the stack or moving focus into it fans the cards out into a list. Vanilla JS, Shadow DOM; built on <kakao-stack> (the pile, fanning, max, motion, corner placement) and needs alert.js. Load stack.js and alert.js first.

attributes.name: position
attributes.description: bottom-right (default) · bottom-left · top-right · top-left. Below 30rem the stack spans the viewport width.

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: How many toasts are visible at once (default 3). Older ones wait hidden behind the stack; their timers don't run.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the region. Default "Notifications".

attributes.name: expanded
attributes.description: Set while the stack is fanned out (the region toggles it).

events.name: toast-show
events.description: { toast }           a toast was added.

events.name: toast-hidden
events.description: { toast, reason }   it left and was removed. reason: close (button or Escape), timeout, method (handle / alert close()), action.

kakao.notFor: Lasting messages: kakao-alert; a decision: kakao-dialog.

declarations.name: KakaoToc
declarations.summary: "On this page" contents for a long page, with a scrollspy.
declarations.description: "On this page": a table of contents for a long page such as a blog article, with a built-in scrollspy. It lists the headings of a target (or links you write), marks the section the reader is in and scrolls there smoothly. Vanilla JS, Shadow DOM, no deps.

attributes.name: for
attributes.description: Where the headings are: an element id, else a CSS selector. Default: the page's <main>, else <body>.

attributes.name: levels
attributes.description: Heading levels to list: a range "2-3" (default) or a list "2,4".

attributes.name: headings
attributes.description: A CSS selector for the headings instead of levels, e.g. ".component-head h2". Their level comes from the tag (h1-h6) or aria-level, else 2. Left out: headings with or inside [data-toc-ignore], inside the toc, and headings that are not rendered (closed dialog, hidden). data-toc-title on a heading sets its entry text. A listed heading without an id gets one from its text ("Café & crème" -> "cafe-creme", "-2" for a duplicate).

attributes.name: list-data
attributes.description: JSON array of hand-written entries (never "data"): { "title", "href" | "id", "children" } or ["Title", "#id"]. Wins over the headings. Without it, a nested <ul>/<ol> of links inside the element is read instead.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark. Default KakaoToc.texts.label ("On this page").

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: Visible title above the list (none by default).

attributes.name: heading-level
attributes.description: Its heading level, default 2.

attributes.name: offset
attributes.description: Pixels from the top of the viewport where a section starts counting as current (and where a jump puts its heading). Default: the page bar's height (--kakao-header-bar-rendered-height) plus 16px, plus the toc's own bar when it is sticky and folded.

attributes.name: sticky
attributes.description: Boolean. Sticks below the page bar (in a sidebar); a list taller than the viewport scrolls inside, keeping the active entry in view.

attributes.name: nested
attributes.description: all (default) · active. all shows every level; active shows deeper levels only under the active top-level entry.

attributes.name: collapse
attributes.description: never (default) · always · auto. Fold the list behind a toggle that shows the title and the current section; auto folds while the viewport is narrower than collapse-below.

attributes.name: collapse-below
attributes.description: CSS length for collapse="auto". Default "48rem".

attributes.name: data-folded
attributes.description: Set by the component while the list is folded (for page CSS).

events.name: toc-change
events.description: { id, title, level, previousId }  the current section changed (id null before the first section).

kakao.notFor: Site navigation: kakao-aside-menu.

declarations.name: KakaoTooltip
declarations.summary: A short label next to a control, also on keyboard focus.
declarations.description: A small themed label next to a control: the name of an icon-only button, or a short hint. Unlike the native `title` it also shows for keyboard focus and for touch (long-press), and it takes the theme's colours. Vanilla JS, Shadow DOM, no deps.

attributes.name: data-tooltip
attributes.description: The label (plain text). data-tooltip="" turns the tooltip off for that element.

attributes.name: data-tooltip-placement
attributes.description: top (default) | bottom | left | right.

attributes.name: for
attributes.description: Id of the anchor (in the same document or shadow root). It may be added later. A dedicated tooltip wins over data-tooltip.

attributes.name: placement
attributes.description: top (default) | bottom | left | right.

attributes.name: inline
attributes.description: Boolean. Draws the label in the text flow, always visible and tied to nothing (previews, documentation).

slots.description: The label (plain text is best; it is read as the description).

kakao.notFor: Rich or interactive content: kakao-popover.

declarations.name: KakaoTreeView
declarations.summary: Nested, collapsible rows: folders, permission groups.
declarations.description: Nested, collapsible rows: folders and files, or permission groups with checkboxes. The WAI-ARIA tree pattern (tree / treeitem / group, one tab stop, arrow keys, type-ahead) with three selection modes and an optional form value. Vanilla JS, Shadow DOM, no deps.

attributes.name: list-data
attributes.description: JSON array of nodes (never "data"). A node is a string (the label) or { "id", "label", "children"?, "icon"?, "expanded"?, "disabled"?, "selected"?, "lazy"? }. icon is one of folder, file, user, users, lock, key, or left out for none. A node without an id gets one from its position ("node-0-2"). "lazy": true marks a node whose children come later (see tree-expand). Wins over a nested list in the element.

attributes.name: selection
attributes.description: single (default) · multiple · none. single: one node is selected, filled like a selected list row. multiple: a checkbox per node; a parent checks or clears everything under it and shows a dash when only some are checked. none: rows only open and close.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: With a form: every selected id is sent under this name (use "perm[]" for PHP / Yii2).

attributes.name: leaves-only
attributes.description: Multiple: value and the form get only the checked nodes that have no children. Without it a fully checked parent is in too.

attributes.name: guides
attributes.description: Draws a thin line down each open level.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the tree. Default "Tree".

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Nothing can be focused, opened or selected; nothing is sent.

events.name: tree-select
events.description: { id, label, selected, value }  the user selected a node, or ticked / cleared it; value is the new list of selected ids.

events.name: tree-expand
events.description: { id, label, lazy }  cancelable, before a node opens. For a lazy node: load its children and call setChildren(id, nodes) (or set loadChildren instead); until then it shows a spinner.

events.name: tree-toggle
events.description: { id, label, expanded }  a node opened or closed.

kakao.notFor: Flat rows: kakao-table; collapsible content: kakao-accordion.
